question: Oda sensei! In Wano Kuni, Hawkins is riding on a really cool animal. What the name of that animal? Is it only available in Wano? - P. N. Shian
answer: Yeah, Komashika, Komachiyo the Komainu, Komadane, Komatori are unique to Wano. The thing they have in common is the flame-like fur. There are a lot more different types of these animals, but I'm not sure if they will get a chance to appear in the story.
name: Shian
